This function runs the ASUFW keep-alive health check.

listitem.para: XST_SUCCESS when the check completes normally.
XPLM_ERR_ASUFW_NOT_ALIVE when the ASUFW counter did not change across three consecutive samples.

inbodydescription.para: Skip check when ASUFW is not present.
Skip check while PLM update is in progress.
Skip keep-alive check while counter is zero, waiting for ASUFW to start incrementing.

Report failure after three consecutive samples with no counter change. ASUFW increments every 100 ms and PLM polls every 200 ms, so the counter must advance at least once between consecutive PLM samples.
